beats.text: This monolith was named Ayers Rock in eighteen seventy three.
It is Uluru, a sandstone monolith in Australia's Northern Territory.
Its base circles nine point four kilometers around.
Archaeological findings show humans settled nearby more than ten thousand years ago.
Uluru is listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
It has been a popular tourist destination since the late nineteen thirties.
It towers three hundred forty eight meters above the desert floor.
